spec_match.rationale: Observes the exact entry types the explainer's example header names (navigation, mark, visibility-state, plus measure) and reproduces the explainer's application/reports+json payload shape byte-for-field, with the synthesized session-end entry explicitly labelled as such.

interactive.rationale: Real PerformanceObserver with buffered delivery, mark/measure buttons that call the real User Timing API, a live entry log, and a real POST to the Reporting-API-shaped endpoint plus a stored-reports readback.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises live recording and a real report POST; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: measure without both marks shows guidance instead of throwing; buffered-replay duplicates are deduped (navigation keyed on identity because its duration keeps updating); unsupported entry types are listed as missing rather than silently dropped.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6594955352080384, the explainer's report-format section, and MDN VisibilityStateEntry.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts exactly the entry types this page depends on and the mark-detail round-trip.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: observers reported active for navigation/mark/measure/visibility-state; clicked both mark buttons, measure, deliver and check; endpoint stored the real payload (application/reports+json, 1291 bytes); zero console errors, zero failed requests; re-ran the full sequence after the final dedupe edit.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts observer activation (dpo-journey-observer-active) and report delivery (dpo-journey-report-post) on success and failure branches.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; scrollable log and payload panels use bordered bg-ivory/bg-stone surfaces with AA text.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons are native with 44px height; the entry log is an <ol> with aria-label and aria-live=polite; observer state and delivery result use role=status.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix ok on both classes; payload panel wraps with overflow-wrap:anywhere so no horizontal overflow at 360px.

openQuestions.title: Visibility-state entries need a manual tab-switch to appear
openQuestions.detail: Headless verification only produces the initial 'visible' entry. A human pass should hide/re-show the tab and confirm hidden/visible entries stream into the log as the page claims.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Batch multiple analytics events into a single beacon rather than sending one request per event.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The page accumulates all observed entries and delivers one consolidated application/reports+json payload — the same batching model the explainer proposes.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Live-updating collections need list semantics and polite announcements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The entry log is an <ol aria-live=polite aria-label> and status lines use role=status.

summary: Verified with headless Chromium 141 over CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud routine): marks, measure, live log, payload assembly and the real endpoint POST all work with a clean console; the buffered-replay duplicate-navigation defect found during review was fixed and the whole sequence re-run from a fresh load.
